questions.question: What is Acme's refund window for physical products?
questions.expected_answer: Customers may request a full refund within 30 days of purchase for unused products in original packaging.

questions.question: Are digital downloads refundable?
questions.expected_answer: Digital downloads and online courses are non-refundable once the license key or access link has been delivered, except for defective products.

questions.question: How long do employees accrue paid annual leave?
questions.expected_answer: Full-time employees accrue 15 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.
